2609.25802.title: Latest Exact Match Attention
2609.25802.paper_summary: We introduce latest exact match attention (LEMA), an attention variant for transformers where queries and keys are binarized and each query attends only to the latest exactly matching key. We prove that LEMA transformers with chain of thought can simulate word-RAMs, as was recently shown for the less restrictive rightmost hard attention. In contrast to prior hard attention variants, the restriction to exact matches enables an efficient converse direction: word-RAMs can simulate LEMA transformers at a cost per token independent of the context length. Together, these results yield a close correspondence between the two computational models in terms of both compute and memory. Beyond the theory, we propose a training method for LEMA transformers that handles their non-differentiable operations with a straight-through estimator for the binarization and a soft attention surrogate annealed towards LEMA. On a synthetic associative recall task, LEMA models trained this way use their growing state to store and recall a large number of associations, outperforming gated DeltaNet (GDN) with its fixed state size. As a first scaling test, we train LEMA language models with up to 834 million parameters. They match softmax transformers of around half their size in loss and, on repeated rare phrases and a needle-retrieval task, remain behind softmax transformers but recall across longer distances than GDN models of comparable size. Finally, we implement dictionary-based inference for LEMA transformers and show constant generation speed comparable to GDN despite their growing state, with the dictionaries residing in main memory rather than VRAM. Code is available at https://github.com/moritzbroe/latest_exact_match_attention.
2609.25802.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹最新的精確匹配注意力（LEMA），這是一種Transformer的注意力變體，其中查詢和鍵被二元化，每個查詢僅關注最新的完全匹配鍵。我們證明了具有思維鏈的LEMATransformer可以模擬字詞隨機存取記憶體（word-RAMs），正如最近對較不限制的最右側硬注意力所顯示的那樣。與先前的硬注意力變體相比，對精確匹配的限制使得一個高效的逆向方向成為可能：字詞隨機存取記憶體可以以每個標記的成本模擬LEMATransformer，而這個成本與上下文長度無關。這些結果共同產生了兩種計算模型在計算和記憶方面的密切對應。超越理論，我們提出了一種LEMATransformer的訓練方法，該方法通過直通估計器處理其不可微分操作，對二元化進行處理，並對向LEMA退火的軟注意力替代品進行處理。在一個合成的聯想回憶任務中，以這種方式訓練的LEMA模型利用其增長的狀態存儲和回憶大量的聯想，超越了具有固定狀態大小的門控DeltaNet（GDN）。作為第一次擴展測試，我們訓練了具有高達8.34億參數的LEMA語言模型。它們在損失上與約一半大小的softmaxTransformer相匹配，並且在重複的稀有短語和針檢索任務中，雖然仍落後於softmaxTransformer，但在回憶上能夠跨越比可比大小的GDN模型更長的距離。最後，我們實現了基於字典的LEMATransformer推斷，並顯示出與GDN相當的恆定生成速度，儘管其狀態不斷增長，字典則存放在主記憶體中而非顯存。代碼可在 https://github.com/moritzbroe/latest_exact_match_attention 獲得。
